title: Head of Recovery Strategy, Process and Programs
description:
About Upstart

Upstart is the leading AI lending marketplace partnering with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit. By leveraging Upstart's AI marketplace, Upstart-powered banks and credit unions can have higher approval rates and lower loss rates across races, ages, and genders, while delivering the digital-first lending experience their customers demand. More than 80% of borrowers are approved instantly, with zero documentation to upload.

Upstart is a digital-first company, which means that most Upstarters live and work anywhere in the United States. However, we also have offices in San Mateo, California; Columbus, Ohio; and Austin, Texas.

Most Upstarters join us because they connect with our mission of enabling access to effortless credit based on true risk. If you are energized by the impact you can make at Upstart, we’d love to hear from you!

The Team

The Recovery team at Upstart is responsible for maximizing post-default recoveries while ensuring compliant, borrower-centric engagement across a diverse and growing vendor ecosystem. As our Recovery operations mature, we are investing in building smarter, more scalable systems that reduce manual risk, improve data-driven decisions, and align our vendor network with long-term strategic outcomes.

We are seeking a Head of Recovery Strategy, Process & Programs to lead our transformation roadmap across vendor integration, automation, compliance infrastructure, and intelligent placement logic. This individual will work cross-functionally across Product, Engineering, Compliance, Legal, Data Analytics, and Operations to architect the next evolution of Recovery operations at Upstart.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Lead Recovery’s transformation roadmap: Design and deliver high-impact initiatives that reduce manual risk, automate vendor workflows, and scale internal process efficiency across legal recovery, bankruptcy, affidavits, DSC, debt sales, and probate.
  • Architect scalable vendor infrastructure: Enhance frameworks for vendor onboarding, integration, compliance scorecards, and audit-readiness, ensuring Recovery is built to scale intelligently across a growing multi-vendor ecosystem.
  • Quantify and optimize placement strategy: Partner with data analytics, ML, and operations to improve liquidation and cost-to-collect through segmentation logic, hypothesis-driven testing, and performance-based routing.
  • Drive analytical and cross-functional execution: Lead strategic programs from concept to implementation—including the rollout of tools like Convoke, legal collections testing, and compliance health models—grounded in measurable ROI and portfolio-level impact.
  • Own Recovery’s strategic alignment layer: Serve as the connective tissue between Product, Engineering, Legal, ML, and Ops to ensure programs are modeled, implemented, and monitored with discipline.
  • Enable performance & quality execution, not manage it: This is a high-ownership individual contributor role. You'll complement operational leadership by enabling managers with scalable tools, systems, and decision frameworks—not by running day-to-day vendor performance.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in product strategy, operations, or transformation program leadership in a regulated or financial services environment
  • Proven success leading analytically rigorous initiatives involving ROI modeling, hypothesis-driven testing, and cost-benefit analysis while leading complex, cross-functional initiatives involving vendors, risk/compliance, and technology teams
  • Demonstrated ability to estimate financial impact at the unit and portfolio level (e.g., revenue per transaction, net present value over time)
  • Demonstrated experience applying process design, automation, or analytics to solve operational problems
  • Excellent project management skills and the ability to organize and drive multiple workstreams
  • Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous problems, develop hypotheses, and present recommendations
  • Excellent communicator: able to synthesize complex analyses into clear, actionable roadmaps
  • Proven analytical skills, with the ability to monitor performance metrics and make data-driven decisions
  • Familiarity with compliance and operational risk frameworks in regulated financial operations
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with a strong sense of urgency

Preferred Qualifications

  • Comfort building and interpreting unit economics models , breakeven analysis, and performance scenarios
  • Experience leading or collaborating on ML- or rule-based segmentation strategies for operational decisioning
  • Strong fluency with quantitative tools (SQL, Excel modeling, Looker, or scripting languages)
  • MBA from a top-tier business school
  • 3+ years of People management experience
  • Strong familiarity with regulated financial services operations or collections/recovery environments
  • Experience in legal collections, recovery optimization, debt sale analytics, or servicing vendor strategy
  • Immense curiosity about root causes—thinks critically from first principles and never stops asking questions
  • A natural thought-partner: open-minded, collaborative, and able to co-create new ideas with cross-functional teams
  • Experience working in fintech, financial services, or consulting (e.g. strategy, risk, vendor management)
  • Familiarity with tools like Convoke, Salesforce, AppScript, or vendor audit and control software
  • Experience with compliance, vendor due diligence, or regulatory exam preparation

Position location

This role is available in the following locations: Remote.

Time zone requirements

The team operates on the East/West coast time zones.

Travel requirements

As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

What you\'ll love

  • Competitive Compensation (base + bonus & equity)
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart
  • 401(k) with 100% company match up to $4,500 and immediate vesting and after-tax savings
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
  • Life and disability insurance
  • Generous holiday, vacation, sick and safety leave
  • Supportive parental, family care, and military leave programs
  • Annual wellness, technology & ergonomic reimbursement programs
  • Social activities including team events and onsites, all-company updates, employee resource groups (ERGs), and other interest groups such as book clubs, fitness, investing, and volunteering
  • Catered lunches + snacks & drinks when working in offices

description:
Overview

THE COMPANY: Juul Labs has a mission to transition the world’s billion adult smokers away from combustible cigarettes, eliminate their use, and combat underage usage of our products. We focus on exceptional quality, research, design, and innovation, supported by leading technology investors. We are hiring great talent across engineers, scientists, designers, product managers, operations, customer service, and business professionals.

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES: The Director, Cycle Planning is responsible for leading Juul Labs’ end-to-end commercial cycle planning process—translating strategic priorities into integrated, market-ready execution plans. This role ensures that product launches, promotions, consumer programs, and other commercial activities are strategically sequenced and operationally aligned to maximize business impact.

Reporting to the Sr. Director, Commercial Planning & PMO, the Director will partner with Sales, Brand, Go-to-Market (GTM), Demand Planning, and Operations to define objectives, set target metrics, and align tactical execution plans for each cycle. This includes managing dependencies, identifying risks and conflicts, and ensuring that all commercial activities are timed and resourced to deliver against volume, revenue, and market share goals. The Director will also serve as the central point of coordination for cycle planning inputs across the U.S. and International markets, ensuring integration with demand planning, resource allocation, and commercial governance processes.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the Commercial Cycle Planning Process
    • Own the development and management of JUUL Labs’ commercial cycle plans from strategy definition to execution readiness.
    • Partner with Commercial, Sales, and Brand leaders to set objectives, define KPIs, and prioritize activities within each cycle.
    • Integrate New Product Introductions (NPIs), promotions, and consumer programs into unified execution strategies that align with corporate and market priorities.
    • Maintain a forward-looking view of the cycle calendar to ensure proactive planning and risk mitigation.
  • Strategic Sequencing & Alignment
    • Facilitate cross-functional planning sessions to align activity sequencing for maximum commercial impact.
    • Identify and resolve conflicts, capacity constraints, and dependencies across initiatives.
    • Ensure cycle planning decisions consider operational lead times, regulatory requirements, and market readiness.
    • Partner with Demand Planning to ensure cycle strategies are supported by accurate forecasts and inventory availability.
  • Integration with Demand Planning & Governance
    • Ensure cycle plans are integrated into the broader commercial execution calendar and governance processes.
    • Collaborate with the demand planning team to align forecasts with cycle objectives and promotional plans.
    • Support the Sr. Director, Commercial Planning & PMO in preparing cycle planning updates for the Commercial Executive Team.
  • Planning Tools & Process Improvement
    • Maintain and evolve standardized cycle planning templates, tools, and workflows.
    • Drive process improvements to increase visibility, alignment, and execution efficiency across the commercial organization.
    • Partner with the PMO team to incorporate cycle planning milestones into initiative tracking dashboards.

PERSONAL AND PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 8+ years in commercial planning, marketing operations, or related commercial execution roles.
  • Proven experience managing integrated planning processes that span multiple functions and markets.
  • Strong facilitation and communication skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and drive consensus.
  • Ability to manage complex calendars and dependencies across product launches, promotions, and market programs.
  • Experience in CPG, nicotine/tobacco, or other regulated industries.

Preferred:

  • Experience leading Cycle Planning efforts in a commercial organization
  • Familiarity with enterprise planning tools and demand planning systems.
  • Experience integrating commercial planning with S&OP processes.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business or related field.

  • People. Work with talented, committed and supportive teammates
  • Equity and performance bonuses. Every employee is a stakeholder in our success

  • Excellent medical, dental and vision, disability, and life insurance, plus family support, wellness, legal, and employee assistance program benefits

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Centerstone is among the nation’s leading nonprofit behavioral health systems with thousands of employees dedicated to delivering care that changes people’s lives. A dynamic, well-established organization, we offer rewarding opportunities to serve all ages in a variety of settings. Come talk to us about joining the Centerstone team!

SUMMARY OF POSITION

The Enterprise Risk Manager is responsible for ongoing risk assessment and mitigation as documented in the Risk Management Plan. Develops and maintains systems within the organization to detect, monitor, prevent, organize, measure, investigate, report, and manage patient adverse events, malpractice claims, incident reports, and other indicators of potential patient harm. The organization’s key aims in this area are to be a high reliability organization that integrate a Just Culture framework toward a culture of patient safety.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Coordinates the risk management program for the organization and facilitates patient safety activities within the Centerstone Patient Safety Organization.
  • Performs investigation of potentially reportable incident(s) to local regulatory agencies
  • Interfaces with the on-site investigators reporting potential claims as well as cases of concern by preparation of preliminary reports, and determination of priority of investigation given risk management assessment.
  • Conducts risk assessments, collecting and analyzing documentation, statistics, reports, and market trends.
  • Communicates high risk and/or high-profile events with Centerstone legal representatives and/or external insurance carriers
  • Recommends policies and procedures to identify and address risks in the organizations services and departments.
  • Investigate and analyze actual and potential risks within the organization; assess liability and probability of legal action for potential notification.
  • Review incident/safety concerns with the leadership team to identify systemic issues and facilitate the development of corrective actions. Recommends and implements risk management solutions such as insurance, safety and security policies, business continuity plans, environment of care, or recovery measures.
  • Coordinates with necessary health and safety leaders throughout the organization to ensure an environment of care that is safe for clients and a workplace that is safe for staff and stakeholders
  • Works collaboratively with management and leadership to conduct a comprehensive risk assessment on an annual basis
  • Recommends a risk management plan for the health system on an annual basis
  • Provides data to leadership necessary to inform risk mitigation strategies for the organization

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES

  • Proven management ability and experience including a thorough understanding of quality improvement (QI) processes, tools, and techniques; quality measurement and reporting; root cause analysis and preventive risk management strategies; accrediting bodies’ standards; and state and federal regulations.
  • Knowledge of risk information management systems (RIMS).
  • Ability to effectively interact and lead risk management activities across multi-state locations and business units

QUALIFICATIONS

Education Level

Minimum of Bachelor’s Degree in healthcare related field required

Years of Experience

Minimum of three (3) years of risk related experience in a behavioral healthcare setting required

Certification/Licensure

Currently a certified professional healthcare risk manager (CPHRM), or eligible to obtain within 6 months of hire

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Standing – 20%

Sitting – 80%

Squatting – Occasional

Kneeling – Occasional

Bending – Occasional

Driving – Occasional

Lifting – Occasional

description:
Community Sales Manager

Av. Tancredo Neves, 620
33° andar
Caminho das Árvores
Salvador
Bahia, Brazil

At Regus, we’ve built the world’s largest workspace network so that our customers can work better, faster, happier. Join the team in one of our business centres. Promote our products and services to new and existing customers. Bring more freedom to more people and businesses. And you’ll be able to work better, faster and happier too.

The opportunity

As a Community Sales Manager, you’ll be responsible for the smooth running of your Regus centre while finding ways to increase sales and revenue, helping more and more people enjoy the benefits of flexible working. You’ll motivate your team to create a great working environment to ensure customer satisfaction and retention.

A typical day at Regus

You start the day with an informal team talk over coffee, to plan the day and make sure everyone’s prepared.

With one eye always on reception, you see members turning up and also the first meeting rooms guests arriving. You welcome them and take them to their meeting room, show them the facilities and help them set up their WiFi connections and AV system for their presentation.

Later you have a meeting to learn more about a new member and get to understand his business needs. You think about the other businesses in the centre and how you might be able to introduce him to a couple that may be of interest at the networking event later in the week.

A large company is taking a whole floor of the centre and is moving in next week. You run through the move in detail with the reception team, ensuring the welcome kit is prepared, and all badges and keys are ready for handing over.

At lunchtime a couple walk in enquiring about coworking membership. Your colleague from sales is on their lunch break so you offer them a coffee and give them a tour of the centre, explaining all the benefits of Regus membership.

Later in the afternoon you host a monthly operations meeting for Community Sales Managers from your local cluster of centres, along with the regional Operations Manager. After the meeting you do a final walk around the building, speaking with members, asking how their day went as they start to wind down and head for home.

About you

We’re looking for someone who has the experience and aptitude to manage a smooth running operation. You’ll need to be an accomplished multitasker, able to pre-empt issues before they become problems, and keep a team motivated and focused on service excellence. You also need to be:

  • A good communicator, used to dealing with customers – ideally in the hospitality or events industry
  • Confident, approachable and able to build strong relationships with customers
  • A great manager, who leads by example and knows how to motivate and inspire a team
  • Happy taking ownership of problems and finding ways to solve them
  • Positive, enthusiastic and able to adapt to fast-changing situations
  • Confident using MS Office and other basic IT packages

In addition, you will:

  • Manage the day to day running of the centre, focusing on exceptional customer service
  • Inspire your team of associates, developing their skills to get the best from each team member
  • Promote your centre to new customers and show them how flexible workspace could enhance their business
  • Generate leads by delivering engaging networking events within your community

What we offer

On top of a competitive salary package you’ll enjoy:

  • A bright and inspiring work environment
  • Training and development opportunities

Estamos em busca de um Comprador! Ruby Labs is looking for a Technical Product Owner to lead the development and rollout of the Payment Orchestration System. This role is central to aligning engineering and integration efforts with our product strategy for payments and billing in a fast-paced SaaS environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the delivery of the Payment Orchestration System MVP by coordinating the integration and implementation of new payment service providers, aligning technical initiatives with product strategy.
  • Own and prioritize the product backlog, translating business needs and stakeholder goals into clear, actionable user stories that guide engineering and integration teams.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Integration, Architecture, and the Head of Payments & Billing to ensure timely, high-quality delivery across the payments ecosystem.
  • Define and adapt Agile workflows (SCRUM, Kanban, or hybrid) to fit team dynamics, driving efficiency through daily stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies.
  • Manage and track work progress, ensuring transparency, accountability, and accurate reporting.
  • Maintain up-to-date product documentation, technical specifications, and decision records to foster alignment and knowledge sharing across teams.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for internal stakeholders, providing regular updates on progress, risks, and delivery timelines.
  • Champion Agile and product management best practices to continuously improve team performance, product quality, and customer value delivery.
  • Support QA and UAT efforts to ensure reliability and compliance of payment and billing subsystems.
  • Contribute to cross-functional initiatives as needed, supporting broader product and organizational goals.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Product Owner or Technical Product Manager, preferably in fintech, payments, billing, or SaaS environments.
  • Strong understanding of payment ecosystems, including PSPs, payment orchestration, billing flows, and integration models.
  • Solid knowledge of RESTful APIs, including ability to read API documentation, understand request/response cycles, and collaborate with engineers on interface definitions.
  • Familiarity with SDKs and developer tools; capable of supporting integration efforts and assessing third-party SDK capabilities.
  • Basic programming/scripting knowledge (e.g. JavaScript, Python, or similar) to support technical discussions, perform lightweight testing, or work with tools like Postman and Swagger.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies (SCRUM, Kanban, or hybrid models); ability to lead Agile ceremonies and continuously improve team workflows.
  • Proficiency with product and project management tools (e.g. JIRA, Confluence, Plane.so, Outline).
  • Ability to write clear and concise user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical documentation.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to bridge technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional teams, especially Engineering, Architecture, QA, and external partners.
  • Prior experience with PCI compliance, fraud prevention, or billing automation in a product context.
  • Knowledge of testing frameworks and data analysis tools (e.g. Looker, SQL) for product insights and validation.
  • Previous involvement in system migrations, particularly payment infrastructure transitions or tool replacements.

Location

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply as long as they are located within approximately ±4 hours of CET to ensure optimal collaboration during working hours.

  • Remote Work Environment: Work from anywhere to support work-life balance.

  • Paid National Holidays: Paid time off on national holidays.
  • Company-provided MacBook: Equipment provided as needed.
  • Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Autonomy and flexibility with related benefits.

  • First Interview (approx. 35 minutes)

At Ruby Labs, we move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. We seek ambitious, driven individuals who want to grow and make an impact.

  • Act as a key contact for client inquiries, support, and all key deliverables
  • Occasional travel requirements up to 25% of the year to meet client needs

Role Requirements

  • 5-7 years in client-facing roles (client management, customer success, or similar)

  • Previous experience in the healthcare Payment Integrity space highly preferred
  • Analytical strength to observe, understand questions, and explain answers in healthcare claims data
  • Excellent communication skills, adept at presenting materials and speaking on topics extemporaneously
  • Ability to work with a range of individuals and manage multiple requests with fast turnaround
  • Driven self-starter mindset, eager to collaborate in a cross-functional environment
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and operate autonomously

What Success Looks Like…

After 1 year

  • You have established a strong network of internal relationships and are recognized as a key collaborator
  • You’ve been entrusted with greater responsibility indicating company confidence in your abilities
  • You see opportunities for career progression and personal development

Pay range : $130,000-$175,000 USD; role is eligible for Annual Performance Bonus

This is an exempt position. The salary range is for Base Salary. Compensation will be determined based on several factors including, but not limited to, skill set, years of experience, and geographic location.

What’s in it for you

  • Flexible Time Off (FTO)
  • Eligibility for health, vision, and dental coverage, 401(k) with company match, and flexible spending accounts
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Eligibility for company-paid benefits including life insurance, short-term disability, and parental leave
  • Remote and hybrid work options

What values we’ll share with you

  • Ask why
  • Think big
  • Be humble
  • Optimize for customer impact

At Machinify, we’re reimagining a simpler way forward. We are innovators who value integrity, teamwork, accuracy, and flexibility. We do the right thing and listen to client needs. We champion diverse perspectives to better serve our clients.

description:
Overview

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we\'re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms. Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

Job Title

Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location

Remote

Employment Type

Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

Role and Responsibilities

  • We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master\'s or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs).
  • As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences.
  • This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology.
  • Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model\'s reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master\'s or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory & non-billable.

description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in 11 countries, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to our Integrations team in Brazil. This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

As an engineer, you will be responsible for developing highly scalable services and ensuring best software engineering practices are followed. You will have opportunities to participate in architectural decisions, suggest improvements, and interact with the product team and other stakeholders in a collaborative agile environment.

As a senior developer, you are expected to design highly scalable systems from scratch, deliver with minimal guidance, become an expert in the business rules and architecture of our complex environment, and mentor less experienced developers.

As part of the Integrations team, you will design and build scalable APIs, manage the integration process between Wellhub and partners (Club Management Systems), and implement new features at the Partners Portal. This team works on products such as booking and access control APIs; for example, all bookings at Wellhub use this API.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Driven to deliver timely, high-quality work. Perform insightful pull-request reviews and build reusable code for future use
  • Be data-driven and participate in and/or lead architectural decisions, share improvement opportunities, bring innovation, and keep design docs up to date
  • Interact with product team and stakeholders to influence the business
  • Ensure successful deliveries and promote long-term technical health of our journeys
  • Take ownership of critical features, accountable and proactive in following up engineering and product KPIs
  • Maintain high code quality standards, ensuring developers are proud of their work
  • Provide technical guidance for your team, spreading development best practices such as code review, pair programming, and TDD; eager to learn and share knowledge
  • Mentor less experienced developers
  • Participate in incident resolution and production troubleshooting
  • Live the mission: promote wellbeing in the workplace and create a supportive environment where colleagues feel comfortable taking care of themselves

WHO YOU ARE

  • A true team player who works toward both team and individual goals with experience in web development
  • Experience designing and developing complex modern web applications
  • Experience with at least two programming languages such as Go, Scala, Kotlin, or Java
  • Experience with SQL/NoSQL technologies (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB, Redis) and understanding performance considerations
  • Experience with event-driven architectures and message brokers (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ, SNS) and understanding their use cases
  • Experience implementing prototypes and in practices like MVP, A/B testing, and feature toggles for production rollout
  • Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, problem-solving, and complex analysis
  • Experience with monitoring, observability, and KPI tracking
  • Experience with microservices and high-volume distributed systems
  • Experience with cloud-based architectures in AWS
  • Strong communication skills in English and Portuguese
  • Ability to work both autonomously and collaboratively
  • Self-starter who can multi-task and adapt to a fast-growing organization
  • Enjoys working on multiple priorities and projects
  • Tenacious and goal-oriented

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some benefits according to your needs.

Our benefits include:

  • WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, and mental wellbeing support. You can add up to three family members to your plan.
  • WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with personalized journeys and 52 per year of individual therapy sessions plus on-demand content.
  • HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.
  • FLEXIBLE WORK: Flexible First company with hybrid and remote options; home office reimbursement available.
  • FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Shape how and when you work to fit time zones and personal routines.
  • PAID TIME OFF: Vacation after 6 months, plus annual PTO increments and birthday holiday.
  • PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: 100% paid parental leave with ramp-back options for part-time return.
  • CAREER GROWTH: Development programs, personalized roadmaps, and internal opportunities.
  • CULTURE: A collaborative, inclusive culture that values diverse perspectives.

We are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive environment and are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other protected status.

description:
Overview

About Skillshare

Skillshare is the leading learning community for creatives. With more than 30,000 expert-led classes in illustration, design, photography, video, marketing, and more, Skillshare empowers anyone, anywhere to learn new skills, share expertise, and unlock their creative potential.

Hundreds of thousands of member subscribers around the world come to Skillshare to discover new passions, advance careers, and connect with an inspiring community of teachers and peers.

Backed by top investors including Newspring Capital, OMERS Ventures, and Union Square Ventures, our mission is to build the world’s most thriving creative learning community.

The Role

We’re looking for a data-driven and strategic Paid Search Manager to own and optimize our campaigns across the Google Ads portfolio. Reporting to the Performance Marketing Lead, you will be responsible for driving profitable growth and maximizing subscription volume at an efficient CAC. This role sits at the core of our growth engine, requiring a deep understanding of campaign management, data analysis, and cross-functional collaboration to drive subscriptions and improve conversion rates across the funnel. You will be responsible for strategy, execution, and reporting, making data-driven decisions to scale our paid search efforts effectively.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize campaigns across the full Google Ads portfolio, including Search, PMax, YouTube, Video Action, and others.
  • Lead keyword strategy and bidding across both branded and non-branded queries to maximize subscription volume at an efficient CAC.
  • Run a disciplined test-and-learn program across bidding, targeting, and funnel variations, and partner with internal data teams to evolve dashboards that surface actionable insights.
  • Drive Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) initiatives within your channels by working cross-functionally with engineering and design to develop, implement, and maintain a testing roadmap.
  • Monitor campaign performance, generate actionable insights from data, and communicate data-driven decisions to key stakeholders.
  • Stay current on Google Ads and performance marketing trends, platform changes, privacy regulations, attribution strategies, and AI-powered search features to maximize performance.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: You have 3+ years of hands-on experience managing SEM and running PPC campaigns in Google Ads, ideally in a fast-paced environment like a subscription business or an agency.
  • Data-driven mindset: You have fluency in campaign data analysis and optimization, with proficiency in Google Sheets, cohort analysis, and ROAS modeling. You have a proven ability to translate numbers into actions.
  • Platform Expertise: You have a strong understanding of search and Google-owned ad placements, including Search, PMax, YouTube, App Campaigns, and Demand Gen.
  • Cross-functional collaborator: You have the ability to work effectively with product, web, creative, and analytics teams to optimize acquisition performance from end to end.
  • Excellent communicator: You can translate complex insights into clear decisions and communicate effectively to stakeholders within and outside of the marketing team.
  • Strategic owner: You are comfortable owning strategy, execution, and reporting, and are curious, commercially aware, and comfortable making quick decisions.
  • Mission alignment: You’re excited by Skillshare’s vision of building the world’s most thriving creative learning community.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with other performance marketing channels such as Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Reddit and others.
  • Experience with international markets outside of the US or managing global accounts.
  • Experience within startup or scale-up environments.
  • Experience working with ed-tech or subscription based companies.

At Skillshare, we believe creativity thrives in an inclusive environment. We’re excited to meet candidates from all backgrounds and experiences. If you’re passionate about what we do but don’t check every single box, we’d still love to hear from you — curiosity and growth matter most to us.

Our Company

Tenchi is a Cyber Security company building innovative technology focused on Third-Party Cyber Risk Management for businesses. Founded by serial entrepreneurs and supported by solid institutional investors, we are driven to disrupt this fast-growing industry.

Our TPCRM SaaS solution, Zanshin, is the only global TPCRM solution that offers both inside-out and outside-in visibility – combining external attack surface monitoring with automated, continuous, and non-intrusive assessments of cloud infrastructure (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) and security controls.

At Tenchi, we build innovative technology to help companies secure their ecosystems with transparency and peace of mind. We are ambitious and purpose-driven. title: Product Filing Lead
description:
About Ethos

Ethos was built to make it faster and easier to get life insurance for the next million families. Our approach blends industry expertise, technology, and the human touch to find you the right policy to protect your loved ones.

We leverage deep technology and data science to streamline the life insurance process, making it more accessible and convenient. Using predictive analytics, we are able to transform a traditionally multi-week process into a modern digital experience for our users that can take just minutes! We’ve issued billions in coverage each month and eliminated the traditional barriers, ushering the industry into the modern age. Our full-stack technology platform is the backbone of family financial health.

We make getting life insurance easier, faster and better for everyone.

Our investors include General Catalyst, Sequoia Capital, Accel Partners, Google Ventures, SoftBank, and the investment vehicles of Jay-Z, Kevin Durant, Robert Downey Jr and others. This year, we were named on CB Insights' Global Insurtech 50 list and BuiltIn's Top 100 Midsize Companies in San Francisco. We are scaling quickly and looking for passionate people to protect the next million families!

About the Role

Ethos is seeking a dynamic expert to take ownership of our regulatory product and forms filing. In this role, you’ll blend hands-on regulatory acumen with forward-looking product innovation to bring life insurance solutions to the market efficiently and compliantly. You’ll collaborate with carriers and cross-functional teams to navigate complex state regulations, ensuring new products and policy forms are designed, filed, and approved seamlessly. Your industry relationships and deep subject-matter expertise will be essential to influence regulators, shape product designs, and accelerate approvals.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead Filing: Own and manage the Ethos portion of the filing process for policy forms and applications, ensuring speed, compliance, and quality.
  • Inform Product Development Strategy: Collaborate with Product, Underwriting, Legal, Compliance, and carrier partners to refine product features and applications that balance innovation with regulatory standards.
  • Optimize Application Design: Provide expert guidance on bracketing, reflexive questions, and variability, enabling flexible yet compliant product offerings.
  • Monitor Industry Trends: Stay ahead of regulatory changes and competitor filings, translating insights into tangible strategies and recommendations for product evolution.
  • Improve Processes Continuously: Innovate on filing processes by implementing best practices and technology solutions, bolstering efficiency and accuracy.

Qualifications and Skills

  • 5+ years in product form filings with strong understanding of state insurance department standards and requirements.
  • Broad knowledge of insurance products and regulatory frameworks.
  • Ability to read and interpret laws and regulations related to product and endorsement forms and filings.
  • Proven ability to shape and refine insurance applications, other new business and disclosure forms, and related statements of variability based on internal, Carrier, and Regulator feedback.
  • Strong collaborative communication skills.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with carriers, legal, and compliance, UW, product development and product teams.
  • Highly self-sufficient and entrepreneurial, capable of driving both strategic initiatives, day-to-day filings, and forms creation and maintenance.
  • Experience in SERFF system a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; JD, CPCU, FLMI, or AIRC a plus.
  • Ownership: Take the reins of product regulatory filings and guide the creation of innovative solutions.
  • Industry Influence: Build on your regulator relationships and shape the market through strategic advocacy.
  • Impactful Collaboration: Partner with a wide range of teams to harmonize regulatory needs with product vision.
  • High-Growth Environment: Join a rapidly evolving organization where your expertise can drive both immediate and long-term success.

If you’re ready to lead the charge in filing next-generation life insurance products—from concept to approval—we’d love to connect!

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Freight Coordinator to join the Logistics team of one of our valued clients.   • Excel
  • Google Sheets

  • Slack
  • Zoom
  • Monday.com

Qualifications:

  • At least 3-5 years of freelancing experience
  • 2+ years of experience in freight coordination, logistics, or supply chain support, ideally with retail and/or 3PL exposure.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple shipments and exceptions simultaneously.
  • Experience working with ERP (e.g., Netsuite), TMS (Transportation Management Systems), WMS (Warehouse Management Systems), or shipment tracking tools.
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Proficiency with Excel and Google Sheets for shipment tracking and reporting.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote/offshore environment and manage time zones effectively.

Preferred:

Role Purpose

The Service Delivery Manager is accountable for a particular service that is delivered by a Managed Service Provider (MSP) or a set of providers. This individual ensures effective delivery of services in order to meet or exceed business expectations for such services, while achieving appropriate balance between quality of outcomes, risk to systems and customers, and the life cycle cost of such services.

    • Integration products - HL7 engines (HealthConnect, Corepoint) and MFT tools like Move IT.
    • Analytics products - Enterprise Data warehouses like Business Objects, SSIS Jobs, ETL tools like Informatica, Decision Support Systems, EMR/EHR Systems Reporting, Visualization tools like Tableau, and Looker
    • Cloud Data Operations - Support ETL hosted on GCP/Azure platforms etc. Tool stack includes Airflow, DataProc, Dataflow, BigQuery, PubSub.
    • Interoperability products - Local and public Health Information Exchanges, Master Data Management tools like NextGate, and Symedical etc.
  • Service Delivery
    • Monitors service execution to ensure that services are delivered within agreed upon service levels and that both users and business partners are satisfied
    • Proactively monitors and measures service performance and metrics on a day-to-day basis to ensure optimal service delivery
    • Serves as an initial point of escalation for significant incidents that interrupt service availability or diminish performance
    • Coordinates and mediates cross-vendor/internal team delivery issues, in collaboration with the Service Integration and Management organization, as required
    • Ensures compliance of service delivery by MSP within scope of responsibility, in accordance with defined service levels, and contractual obligations
    • Plans for a mechanism to measure the impact of corrective actions and associated implications on MSP costs/charges
    • Reviews and approves root cause analysis for systemic issues within the production environment
    • Identifies the need, reviews, and/or approves service improvement plans to address problems or improve service
    • Reviews and approves capacity planning reports
    • Participates in joint planning activities and shares necessary information that enables MSP(s) / third party vendors to provide better support
    • Understands the scope of MSP services and the potential for rationalizing the MSP portfolio to decrease cost of delivery and/or enhance quality of services
    • Within MSP contracted obligations, identifies possible existing services that may be leveraged for new/improved business solutions
    • Validates that corporate architectural guidelines, standards, policies (e.g., security, risk, etc.) are followed
  • Service Level Management
    • Negotiates service level agreements with vendors and holds them accountable for consistent delivery
    • Demonstrates a detailed understanding of service management processes, service level agreements and contracts, and assesses whether they are appropriate or require modification
    • Monitors and reports on service levels; reviews and approves MSP delivered SLAs
  • Financial Management
    • Knows how to plan, forecast, budget and track IT costs
    • Aligns spending with strategic objectives and improves cost and price transparency for business partners
    • Develops and manages the budget for the “run” operations and sustainment of capability (CapEx/OpEx) for a particular service
    • Reviews and validates vendor and/MSP invoices; compares against budget, including supporting the resolution of discrepancies
  • Other Leadership Responsibilities
    • Evaluates, designs and/or implements process or technology changes that enhance effectiveness and/or efficiency
    • Recommends technology improvement opportunities to the leadership and architecture teams for increasing IT value while decreasing cost of delivery
    • Oversees technology lifecycle management for system components that support the delivery of service(s) under span of control
    • Understands and applies risk management policies and procedures appropriately

  • Communicates and interacts effectively at various levels of the organization including senior leadership, business stakeholders and technical subject matter experts

  • Demonstrates accountability for meeting commitments and deadlines
  • Demonstrates alignment of principles, values, and behavior with expected organizational culture and values

Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.

We are looking for a highly motivated and enthusiastic Junior Backend Software Engineer to join our B2B Acquisition team in Brazil (Remote) .

The Marketing Engineering & Platform team is part of the Engineering Product Development tribe inside Wellhub. We work on a daily basis with the Marketing team to ensure that their strategies are built and deployed in the highest quality standards.

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain and improve services focusing on performance, scalability, and resilience;

  • Work with cutting-edge technologies and edge cases on a global scale;
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

  • You're a backend engineer with experience building scalable and high-performing web applications.
  • You have experience developing modern web applications and working with cloud-based architectures.
  • You're proficient in one or more programming languages, such as Go, Java, or Kotlin.
  • You have a solid understanding of developing RESTful web services, asynchronous processing, event-driven architectures, collaborating with front-end teams to define APIs, create mocks, and follow HTTP best practices.

  • You have professional working proficiency in English and can articulate ideas clearly in technical discussions.
  • You hold a bachelor’s degree in computer science or have equivalent professional experience.

We are a wellness company committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits according to your needs.

Overview


We’re looking for a Senior Manager to help lead our growing Transaction Advisory Services (TAS) team.


This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who is passionate about financial due diligence and M&A strategy, and has the desire to take the lead in helping expand a service line. If you join the team, you will lead projects that shape the future of businesses, working with a highly collaborative team that values precision, insight, integrity and superior client service. You’ll be integral to developing the framework for the team, while leveraging your experience to build on what we have.


If you are a self starter who thrives in fast-paced environments, enjoy working directly with executives, and have a knack for uncovering the story behind the numbers, this could be your next big move.



Work arrangement


Our tax and audit teams may be spread across the country, but they work together seamlessly and successfully – and unlike many of our competitors, we have not had an RTO mandate. That said, we require this position to be situated locally to the Portland or Seattle market – you are working with local business leaders, after all.


Interested in moving to Portland? That works too – and we will help cover the cost. Please be explicit about this in your resume or cover letter if you choose to do one.

A culture where flexibility and balance add up to success.


We know that advisory work can be intense, which is why we’ve built a culture that respects your time, values your expertise, and supports your growth. Our expectations are clear and reasonable, and we work together to meet deadlines without burning out.


While this role does not have chargeable hours expectations, you will need to be adept and flexible to react to deal flow, which means riding the peaks and valleys that come with the work. Rest assured, you won’t be a lone wolf – and you’ll be surrounded by smart, driven professionals who believe in working hard and celebrating wins—together.



Recharge and benefits


Recharge and refocus.


We believe in balance. That’s why we offer generous time off, including 5 weeks of PTO , 14.5 paid holidays , and paid leave options, including parental leave. We want you to bring your best self to work—and that starts with taking care of yourself.



Qualifications



  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration (required)

  • CPA (preferred)

  • 7+ years of public accounting experience, including 3+ years in financial audit or TAS (preferred)

  • Previous Due Diligence experience (preferred)

  • Strong knowledge of US GAAP and technical accounting areas

  • Proven ability to lead due diligence engagements, including quality of earnings, working capital, and financial analysis

  • Experience interacting with C-level executives and managing client relationships

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to successfully adapt and convey messages to all levels of management

  • Demonstrated project management experience, and strong analytical skills to identify and support issues and resolutions to deal structures

What you’ll do



  • Lead and manage financial due diligence engagements for buy- and sell-side transactions, including serving as primary contact for duration of due diligence process

  • Analyze quality of earnings, working capital, forecasts, and key financial metrics of target client

  • Identify risks and issues impacting deal structure and purchase agreements

  • Identifies and proposes appropriate resolutions on a timely basis for critical issues related to the M&A process

  • Oversee preparation of financial due diligence reports and present findings to clients

  • Manages the development of proposal documents, and conducts presentations in pursuit of acquiring new clients

  • Build and maintain strong client relationships and identify business development opportunities

  • Collaborates cross departmentally to identify and promote the services of the TAS practice to existing and prospective clients, in addition to identifying cross-selling opportunities to other services lines

  • Mentor and develop TAS team members



Compensation and benefits



  • Salary range is $165K - $185K annually, varying DOE. Compensation may be adjusted for those who live in areas with a higher cost of labor than Portland, OR

  • 401(k) profit sharing plan; immediate vesting of employer contributions

  • 14.5 paid holidays, 5 weeks of paid time-off (PTO), parental leave

  • Incentive plan for sales leads



A company you’ll feel proud to be part of


We don’t like to brag, but we have some significant accolades under our belt—all thanks to our passionate teams. At Perkins, we feel good about our work and love that our community feels good about it, too.



  • #1 Most Admired Accounting firm in Oregon & SW Washington. 16 years on Oregon's Most Admired Companies list (Portland Business Journal)

Department

The Legal team at Signifyd plays a critical role in enabling and protecting the business as it scales. Our team is responsible for drafting and negotiating contracts, reviewing privacy and data protection matters, supporting product development, and overseeing corporate governance. We work closely with the Sales, Partnerships, Product, Revenue Operations (RevOps), and Finance teams to help drive business objectives forward. By shaping processes that accelerate deal cycles, we help keep the commercial flywheel turning. At the same time, we ensure Signifyd’s risk exposure is carefully managed and our sensitive data is safeguarded through robust contractual protections.

Role

As a Legal Operations and Contracts Manager , you’ll help shape and optimize our legal systems and contracting processes while also drafting, reviewing, and negotiating agreements. You’ll collaborate with teams across the company to streamline deal cycles, improve our Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) tools, and support critical agreements such as NDAs, MSAs, and order forms.

We’re a lean team, so your impact will be felt immediately. This is a hands-on role with significant opportunities for growth, perfect for someone who can balance business objectives with legal considerations, enjoys cross-functional collaboration, and thrives in a fast-moving environment.

Responsibilities

  • Contract Negotiation: Review, draft and negotiate a variety of contracts, including nondisclosure agreements, master service agreements and statements of work.
  • Contract Lifecycle Management: Manage the entire contract lifecycle from intake and drafting to negotiation, execution, and renewal, including maintaining and managing our contract repository and electronic databases.
  • Sales and Stakeholder Advisory: Act as a primary point of contact for the sales team and other internal stakeholders, providing guidance and coordination throughout the contract lifecycle to ensure efficient and compliant deal execution.
  • Process Optimization: Develop, maintain, and enforce policies and standard operating procedures for legal and contracting processes. Continuously identify opportunities to accelerate contract closure by enhancing templates, streamlining negotiation workflows, and clarifying escalation guidelines.
  • System Administration: Act as the primary legal team interface with other departments in structuring cross-departmental functions, including the establishment and enhancement of company-wide IT systems, particularly our CLM tool.
  • Reporting and Analytics: Manage standard and ad-hoc reporting and metrics related to contract volume, turnaround times, and other key performance indicators to inform strategic decisions.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work collaboratively with the team to continually identify opportunities to accelerate contract closure, respond to inquiries effectively, and develop comprehensive contracting policies.
  • Innovation Champion: Be a champion for a better, faster, and simpler way of doing things within the legal and contracting functions.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience in a legal operations or contract management role.
  • 4+ years proven experience drafting and reviewing commercial contracts, including MSAs, Order Forms, and NDAs.
  • Demonstrated experience managing the full contract lifecycle process and administration in a time-sensitive environment.
  • Experience managing legal technology, including CLM (Contract Lifecycle Management) tools, and managing integrations between systems. Familiarity with Ironclad, Zip, Salesforce, or similar platforms is a strong plus.
  • A self-starter who works with minimal supervision and high integrity, while also being a strong and collaborative team player.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate legal and business concepts to a variety of audiences.

This position can be based anywhere in the US, either fully remote or in one of our offices in San Jose, Seattle, Denver, or NYC.

What does this role involve?

As a Store Manager you will be accountable for your store's performance, maximising sales through physical and digital channels, and achieving store targets by leading an inclusive and diverse team that consistently demonstrate the BHF values. Each day is different in this varied, fast paced and hands on role. At the British Heart Foundation (BHF) we offer a huge range of new and used quality furniture, clothing, jewellery and more, available in store and online.

Our vision is a world where everyone has a healthier heart for longer. We fund cutting-edge research and innovation to save and improve more lives. In addition to raising funds, we connect with local communities and help reduce clothing and furniture waste across the UK. With over 700 stores we make a significant environmental impact by preventing around 70,000 tonnes of unwanted items from going to landfill each year. We receive 1.6 million items donated to our home stores and 9.8 million bags of donated items, and we will continue to build on our reuse agenda in the years to come.

Our Equality, Diversity and Inclusion (EDI) Strategy, Igniting Change, along with our internal EDI group, Kaleidoscope, and a growing number of employee network groups (Affinity Groups), help us create an environment where all colleagues and volunteers can succeed.

Clutch is a revolutionary vertical SaaS company, proudly backed by Andreessen Horowitz (A16z), aimed at revolutionizing the way Credit Unions engage and change the lives of their members. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. About the role

At Innodata, we are working with the world's largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We are looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts. We are seeking a Physics Subject Matter Expert with exceptional writing and analytical skills to join our AI/ML data team.

description:
About Remote

Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

What this job can offer you

The Senior Partner Solutions Architect is a strategic technical leader responsible for driving the successful integration of partners onto the Remote platform. This role acts as the primary technical bridge between our products and our partners' needs, owning the technical relationship from pre-sales qualification through to post-sales implementation and scaling. The ideal candidate will combine deep API and integration expertise with strong consultative skills to design and deliver high-value solutions that accelerate partner-driven revenue and expand Remote’s ecosystem.

What you bring

  • Experience creating high-quality technical documentation, training materials, and enablement resources.

  • Writes and speaks fluent English

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner-Facing Technical Leadership
    • Lead the technical sales cycle for strategic partnerships, conducting discovery sessions, delivering tailored API-focused product demonstrations, and designing robust integration solutions.

  • Technical Enablement & Scaling
    • Develop and maintain a comprehensive library of technical enablement materials, including implementation guides, best practice documents, and technical readmes for both partners and internal teams.
    • Create and improve scalable resources, such as the open-source "Remote API Demo" application, to enhance partner engagement and streamline the sales process.
    • Serve as a subject matter expert on Remote’s API and integration capabilities, providing internal training and acting as an onboarding buddy to scale the collective expertise of the Solutions Architect team.
  • Strategic Collaboration & Product Influence
    • Act as a key technical liaison between partners, sales, product, and engineering teams to ensure tight alignment on Remote Embedded product roadmaps and technical deliverables.
    • Translate partner and customer requirements into detailed product requirements and business requirements, identifying product gaps and advocating for enhancements based on market feedback.
    • Contribute to the continuous improvement of the Solutions Architect function by refining processes, introducing new tools, and providing strategic input on team growth.
  • Measures of Success
    • Increased win rates and revenue growth from partner-driven opportunities.
    • High partner and customer satisfaction scores based on the quality and effectiveness of technical solutions.
    • Successful delivery and adoption of partner integrations.
    • Tangible contributions to the team's knowledge base and the scaling of the Solutions Architect function.

Practicals

Remote's Total Rewards philosophy is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair equity pay along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate. We hope to inspire other companies to support global talent-hiring and bring local wealth to developing countries.

At first glance our salary bands seem quite wide - here is some context. At Remote we have international operations and a globally distributed workforce. We use geo ranges to consider geographic pay differentials as part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive in various markets while we hiring globally.

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay for the successful candidate in this role is dependent upon many factors such as location, transferable or job-related skills, work experience, relevant training, business needs, and market demands. Benefits

You will be empowered to take ownership and be proactive. When in doubt you will default to action instead of waiting. Your life-work balance is important and you will be encouraged to put yourself and your family first, and fit work around your needs.

What You Will Do

Role Purpose

The Cloud Service Delivery Manager is accountable for the public cloud infrastructure environment supported by Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and/or Cloud Operations teams. This individual ensures that services are delivered effectively to meet or exceed business expectations while balancing quality, risk, and cost. The role requires strong vendor management, IT service delivery expertise, and leadership in cross-functional collaboration.

  • Service Delivery
    • Monitor and ensure delivery of services within agreed service levels and contractual obligations.

    • Proactively track and measure service performance and metrics, ensuring issues are documented, resolved, and communicated effectively.

    • Identify opportunities to optimize MSP portfolios and leverage existing services for improved business outcomes.

  • Incident & Major Incident Management
    • Serve as an escalation point for significant incidents and coordinate resolution efforts.
    • Join and actively manage bridges for Major Incidents (MIBs), particularly those impacting hospitals or national services.
    • Ensure incident communications follow established playbooks and that ServiceNow records are accurate and complete.
    • Participate in after-hours on-call rotation for critical incident management.
  • Service Level Management
    • Negotiate, review, and enforce SLAs with vendors and MSPs.
    • Monitor SLA performance, ensuring accountability for consistent delivery.

Financial Management (in collaboration with FinOps)

  • Reviews vendor/MSP invoices for accuracy, partners with FinOps to resolve discrepancies, and ensures costs align with budgets and forecasts.
  • Provides service delivery insights to improve cost transparency for business partners.

  • Recommends technology or process improvements that enhance IT value and may reduce delivery costs.

Governance, Risk & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with organizational risk management policies and IT security standards.
  • Manage waiver and CEP exemption reviews and approvals.
  • Oversee technology lifecycle management for infrastructure components.
  • Drive audit readiness and follow-up for customer survey investigations and compliance assessments.

Vendor & Resource Management

  • Manage MSP onboarding/offboarding in HR and vendor systems (PeopleSoft, Beeline, SailPoint).
  • Oversee account provisioning, expirations, and access management (including CyberArk and privileged account standards).
  • Build strong vendor relationships, fostering accountability, transparency, and collaboration.

Leadership & Communication

  • Communicate effectively across all levels of the organization, including executives, business stakeholders, and technical SMEs.
  • Facilitate conflict resolution and negotiations with MSPs and internal teams.
  • Demonstrate urgency, accountability, and proactive problem-solving.
  • Write clearly and tailor communications to the appropriate audience.
  • Build trust, collaboration, and alignment with organizational values and culture.

Ideal Qualifications

  • 5+ years of IT service delivery management, including direct oversight of MSPs.

  • Proven financial acumen in IT budgeting, forecasting, and cost transparency.

  • 3+ years of leadership or management experience.
  • Healthcare provider industry experience.
  • Certification credentialed from the International Association of Information Technology Asset Managers (IAITAM).

Key Competencies

  • Strong leadership and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to manage complex vendor relationships and cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, negotiation, and influencing skills.
  • Proactive, adaptable, and able to manage competing priorities.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive service improvement, cost efficiency, and value delivery.

Education:

  • High School diploma equivalency with 3 years of cumulative experience OR Associate's degree/Bachelor's degree with 2 years of cumulative experience OR 7 years of applicable cumulative job specific experience required.
  • 3 years of leadership or management experience preferred.

No additional preferences.

Your job will be to find them and inform them about all the benefits of living and working in Sweden. To move to another country is often one of the biggest leaps in life, so a lot of your job will be to build trust with suitable candidates.

Supporting you in these tasks, you will have the assistance of a competent global team of recruiters, as well as an executive management team in Sweden. In addition you will be supported by our Swedish delivery management team that handles all practical matters related to the relocation to Sweden for our consultants. In short we fix everything for our employees - visa, work permits, tickets, housing, you name it - we fix it!

Our clients are primarily within the fields of software development, R&D, cyber security, automotive, embedded systems, telecommunications, online solutions and application development. Your work will be planned and executed together with your colleagues in Albania, Argentina, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Brazil, Colombia, Hungary, Kenya, North Macedonia, Sweden, Turkey, Ukraine, Venezuela and Vietnam. title: CDI Validation Specialist
description:
Overview

Position: CDI Validation Specialist

The CDI Validation Specialist assists the CDI Manager with oversight, evaluation, and analysis of CDI functions including efficiency, accuracy, continuing education needs, and overall quality. This individual identifies individual education needs of Clinical Documentation Specialists and collaborates with CDI Manager, IP Coding Manager, and IP Coding Validation Manager to develop appropriate training materials. The primary goal is to ensure the documentation in the chart identifies all clinical findings, diagnoses and procedures and is appropriately and clinically supported. The CDI Validation Specialist will work with the CDI Manager to leverage performance, providing feedback and influence to continually improve documentation results thereby impacting key performance indicators.

Department: Clinical Documentation

Schedule: Full Time

Responsibilities

  • Monitors CDI staff accuracy, data quality and integrity.
  • Monitors CDS review process for content, timeliness and accurate diagnosis and procedure assignment in determining a working DRG.
  • Monitors concurrent queries for compliancy, accuracy, clarity, and timeliness.
  • Audits clinical documentation specialists retrospectively to assess for completeness of chart review and query compliance including missed query opportunities, accurate coding, and adherence to AHIMA/ACDIS compliant query guidelines/standards.
  • Collaborates with CDI manager to identify, coordinate, and implement CDI specialist ongoing education and feedback based on identified opportunities for improvement via auditing.
  • Assists in orientation and training of new clinical documentation specialists
  • Reviews and analyzes denial claims and denial data to provide support in denial prevention strategies via clinical validation query process and education to CDI specialists.
  • Contributes to departmental and organizational quality performance goals, including auditing mortality and readmission cohorts to identify opportunities for improvement. Coordinate and implement CDI specialist education based on identified opportunities.
  • Collaborates with CDI manager to create and update documentation tools, processes, procedures, and work flows on an ongoing and as needed basis.
  • Reviews charts concurrently with no MCC/CCs, low SOI/ROMs and LOS not supported by working DRG.
  • Identifies and educates CDI with missed query opportunities.
  • Assists CDI manager with final DRG validation when there is a discrepancy between CDS and coder.
  • Collaborates with the CDI Manager and identifies opportunities for performance improvement activities on processes.
  • Collaborates with CDI Manager, IP Coding Manager, and IP Coding Validation Manager to strategize appropriate training methodology for individual issues.
  • Provides timely appropriate feedback to CDI Manager on any performance improvement plans for CDI staff.
  • Collaborates with other CDCI department managers to identify areas for improvement and solutions for process improvement.
  • Assures documentation is compliant with federal and state regulations, coding guidelines and hospital policies.
  • Remains up-to-date in clinical and coding/documentation-related materials, including CDS best practices as defined by ACDIS as well as ICD-10-CM/PCS, AHA Coding Clinic guidelines for coding and reporting and MS-DRG/APR-DRG classification systems.
  • Monitors regulatory and reimbursement changes.
  • Serves as resource for CDI informational needs and updates CDI on coding changes, medical science and CDI practice standards.
  • Provides guidance, support and expertise to the CDI specialists
  • Track trends in documentation concerns and implementing solutions for improvement.
  • Uses leadership and critical thinking skills to identify opportunities for team processes and engagement
  • Recommend solutions for improvement when deficiencies are identified.
  • Provides CDI specialists, coders, and coding validation specialists with clinical feedback to assist in accurately capture diagnoses and/or opportunities for querying physicians post discharge for additional information.
  • Evaluates the success of concurrent documentation improvement on an ongoing basis.
  • Advances professional growth and development through participation in educational programs and workshops and maintaining knowledge of industry standards and practices.
  • Assists manager, when requested, in the development of APR/DRG/query response physician reports. Maintains complete confidentiality of patient information in addition to hospital and individual physician practice pattern data.
  • Assumes operational oversight of CDI department in the absence of the CDI manager.
  • Adheres to all BMC’s RESPECT behavioral standards.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Note: The above statements depict the general nature and level of work assigned and are not intended to be an exhaustive list of duties and responsibilities.

Job Requirements

Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in nursing, health information management or related field and at least five years (5) years experience in clinical documentation, or equivalent combination of education and experience, required.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Master's degree

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations Required

  • Licensed RN

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations Preferred

  • CCDS, CDIP

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities (KSAs)
